import json
import os
import signal
import subprocess
import time
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from makemarket.provenance import file_sha256, receipt

root = Path('results/expansion')
path = root / 'llama_duplicate_retry_plan.json'
raw = root / 'raw/cards/meta_llama-3.2-90b-vision-instruct__text-only_.jsonl'
initial = raw.read_bytes()
commands = {game: ['bash', 'scripts/with_resource.sh', 'nim', '.venv/bin/python', '-u',
    'scripts/expand_nim.py', '--models', 'meta/llama-3.2-90b-vision-instruct',
    '--games', game, '--stop-at', '2026-11-01T00:00:00Z',
    '--protocol-file', f'protocol-llama90-{game}-duplicate-retry.json'] for game in ('dice', 'cards')}
if not path.exists():
    record = {'provenance': receipt({'purpose': 'resume the identical cached Llama requests after a specific transient duplicate-request rejection'}),
        'source': Path(__file__).read_text(), 'status': 'registered_waiting_for_commit_and_completed_episode',
        'old_supervisor_pid': 60439, 'commands': commands,
        'old_failure_protocol': 'results/expansion/protocol-llama90-resume.json',
        'old_failure_protocol_sha256': file_sha256(root / 'protocol-llama90-resume.json'),
        'initial_cards_episodes': initial.count(b'\n'), 'initial_cards_sha256': file_sha256(raw),
        'cutoff': 'primary newest-family test acquisition completion or 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z, whichever is earlier',
        'inclusion': 'Only complete 200-episode cohorts may be scored. No outcome-dependent stopping. Same request config and cache; at most two global mutex slots, one sequential process per game.'}
    path.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
    raise SystemExit('Registered; create runs/llama_duplicate_retry_ready after commit/push to resume.')
record = json.loads(path.read_text())
assert record['status'] == 'registered_waiting_for_commit_and_completed_episode'
while not Path('runs/llama_duplicate_retry_ready').exists():
    time.sleep(5)
while True:
    command = subprocess.run(['ps', '-p', '60439', '-o', 'command='], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
    if 'runs/resume_llama_after_mistral.py' not in command:
        record['old_process'] = 'already_finished'
        break
    data = raw.read_bytes()
    if len(data) > len(initial) and data.endswith(b'\n'):
        assert data.startswith(initial)
        assert os.getpgid(60439) == 60439
        os.killpg(60439, signal.SIGTERM)
        record.update(old_process='paused_at_complete_episode', cards_episodes_at_pause=data.count(b'\n'),
            pause_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), preserved_prefix=True)
        break
    time.sleep(1)
old_path = root / 'protocol-llama90-resume.json'
old = json.loads(old_path.read_text())
label = 'meta/llama-3.2-90b-vision-instruct (text-only)'
fields = ('model', 'label', 'timeout_seconds', 'probe_seed', 'probe_round', 'max_tokens', 'temperature',
          'extra_body', 'provenance', 'probe', 'usable', 'probe_wall_seconds')
children = []
for game, command in commands.items():
    protocol = root / f'protocol-llama90-{game}-duplicate-retry.json'
    assert not protocol.exists()
    entry = {k: old[label][k] for k in fields}
    entry['availability_source'] = {'path': str(old_path), 'sha256': file_sha256(old_path)}
    protocol.write_text(json.dumps({label: entry}, indent=2) + '\n')
    log = open(f'runs/llama90_{game}_duplicate_retry.log', 'ab', buffering=0)
    process = subprocess.Popen(command, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, start_new_session=True)
    children.append((game, process))
record.update(status='running', started_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
              launch_provenance=receipt({'commands': commands}), children={g: p.pid for g,p in children})
path.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
while any(p.poll() is None for _,p in children):
    selection_path = Path('results/training/qwen38_selection.json')
    completed = False
    if selection_path.exists():
        selection = json.loads(selection_path.read_text())
        files = [Path(selection['test_root']) / 'raw' / g / f"{selection['label']}.jsonl" for g in ('dice', 'cards')]
        completed = all(f.exists() and len(f.read_text().splitlines()) == 200 for f in files)
    if completed:
        for _, process in children:
            if process.poll() is None:
                assert os.getpgid(process.pid) == process.pid
                os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
        record['stopped_at_primary_test_complete'] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
        break
    time.sleep(30)
record.update(status='finished', finished_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
              exit_codes={g: p.wait() for g,p in children})
path.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
cutoff: primary newest-family test acquisition completion or 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z, whichever is earlier
inclusion: Only complete 200-episode cohorts may be scored. No outcome-dependent stopping. Same request config and cache; at most two global mutex slots, one sequential process per game.
